title: Moonlight Hug Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: When you are looking for a home for a romantic getaway, consider our large one-bedroom cottage ‘Moonlight Hug’. This two-story cottage, one-bedroom home is the guest cottage for ‘Beachside Kiss’. It’s perfect for a small family vacation.
description_expanded: Description159 E. RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 4) PET FRIENDLY UP TO 25 LBS.Prime Seaside Location Near Beach, Downtown & Ruskin ParkMoonlight Hug is ideally located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, just 352 yards from the beach, a 2-minute walk to downtown Seaside, and only one minute from Ruskin Park. Situated just steps from Seaside Avenue, this charming cottage places you within easy walking distance of over 35 restaurants, boutiques, and local shops. With a private off-street driveway, you can park once and enjoy everything Seaside has to offer on foot. Perfect for a romantic couples’ retreat or a young family vacation, Moonlight Hug is also pet-friendly, so your four-legged companion is welcome to join the fun.Open-Concept Living with Updated KitchenInside, Moonlight Hug features a bright, open-concept floor plan designed for comfort and ease. The updated kitchen is fully equipped for your stay, offering a full-size refrigerator with water dispenser, five-burner electric stovetop, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, and coffee maker. A breakfast bar seats two, with an adjacent bistro dining table providing seating for two more—ideal for casual breakfasts or relaxed dinners after a beach day. The adjacent living area includes a queen sleeper sofa and a large flat-screen TV, creating a cozy space to unwind.Screened Porch for Relaxed Outdoor LivingJust off the living room, a screened-in rear porch offers Adirondack seating for two. This quiet outdoor space is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or winding down in the evening after exploring Seaside.Private King Suite with Screened BalconyUpstairs, the second floor is dedicated to the king primary suite, offering privacy and comfort. The bedroom includes a closet, flat-screen TV, and a private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination. Step outside onto your private screened balcony, furnished with Adirondack seating for two—an ideal spot for a peaceful afternoon break or an evening cocktail.Ideal for Couples or Small FamiliesWhether you’re planning a romantic Seaside getaway or a small family beach vacation, Moonlight Hug offers an unbeatable location and thoughtful amenities, all within a 2–4 minute walk to the beach, parks, and town center. Additional conveniences include a stackable washer and dryer, making longer stays easy and comfortable. Need more space, check out the guest cottage Beachside Kiss. * 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $50 a day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $100 pet fee. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No pet over 25 lbs.FEATURES820 Square FeetPrivate Seaside Residential Beach – Seaside PavilionBeach Access – 3-minute walk, 352 yards to the largest private residential beach on 30APrivate DrivewayWasher & DryerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAmenities Access – 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote – 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service – Starter amenities provided throughout your stayParking & Golf Cart Information – Only 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitPet Friendly – Up to 25 lbsSTR23-002377
